info.description: Run folders 01-05 in order. Set baseUrl, adminEmail and adminPassword in a private environment. Creates unique test accounts and deletes them. Bearer tokens only. Expiration is a separate short-lived-server check.

exec: const token = pm.collectionVariables.get('accessToken'); const i = token.lastIndexOf('.') + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('tamperedToken', token.slice(0, i) + (token[i] === 'a' ? 'b' : 'a') + token.slice(i + 1));

item.description: For a dedicated test instance with JWT_EXPIRES_IN=2, run this folder alone. On the normal 3600-second instance the expiration request is skipped; automated Java tests always cover expired tokens.

exec: pm.test('No password or hash leakage', () => { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).not.to.match(/"password(?:Hash)?"\s*:/i); pm.expect(text).not.to.match(/\$2[aby]\$/); });
